svg.title: Per-method interconnect regions and their checks

g.aria-label: ixn_region = interconnect_region if an adapter narrowed it, else chiplet_attachment_input
evaluated at max of the two IXN_spacing values
without this the gap between dies of different methods
is unchecked; each method region contains only its own pads
checked with the adapter's assembly-global numbers,
and only if an interconnect adapter was supplied;
without an interconnect adapter, the deck reports
each one as IXN.unassociated: not checked,
die boundary polygon from the boundary manifest
unclaimed remainder, covered by no method region
every spacing evaluation subtracts a 10 nm circle tolerance, because a 256-vertex
polygon snapped to a 1 nm grid measures a few nanometres short of a true circle
